meaning:
Γεθσημασεί (Rec. -νῆ, LTr. -νεῖ) indecl. (Heb. גֵּת שְׁמָנִי, oil-press),
Gethsemane: called in Jhn.18:1 a κῆπος, but named only in Mat.26:36, Mrk.14:32.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”
They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I pray.”
